I am old now, 76 years, and my body is tired. This small piece of land near the house, only a small patch, I plant together with other things — maybe some cassava with beans or vegetables for the pot. I have no money for the chemical fertilizer from the shop, and here in Kigoma we do not get much help with these inputs. I will put the small manure I get from chickens and goats around the house, use the seeds I saved from last harvest, and work it myself with my hoe little by little when my strength allows. Sometimes my grandchildren help me when they are not at school.
